description: Surface cartographer docs through the existing doc-health validation pattern; expose cartographer findings to ui-health where useful without duplicating its React parsing logic.

requirements.description: Cartographer's documentation surface must be registered with the knowledge-observatory doc-health validation pattern (AC-INTEGRATION-KO) so that doc coverage and freshness are tracked alongside other scenario docs. Cartographer findings must be exposed to ui-health where useful (AC-INTEGRATION-UH), without duplicating ui-health's React parsing logic. Both integrations must operate without introducing runtime dependencies between cartographer and these external scenarios.
requirements.title: knowledge-observatory and ui-health Integration

validation.notes: AC-INTEGRATION-KO: Cartographer doc manifest entries are parseable by knowledge-observatory's manifest-driven validation logic
AC-INTEGRATION-UH: Cartographer findings export format matches the contract expected by ui-health's findings consumer without React-specific parsing
knowledge-observatory doc-health smoke test: cartographer docs surface registers successfully and doc-health reports no missing entries
ui-health integration smoke test: cartographer findings are visible in ui-health dashboard without errors
Removing cartographer does not break knowledge-observatory or ui-health runtime behavior
Cartographer docs appear in the organization's doc-health dashboard alongside other scenarios
ui-health consumers see architecture conflict findings without needing to run cartographer directly

title: knowledge-observatory + ui-health Integration
